result.accessibility:
The ground floor of the Hangar is accessible to all visitors, including people with disabilities and mobility challenges.

Please note that some activities and events will take place on the mezzanine level, which is accessible only by stairs. There are two stairways: one may be suitable for visitors using crutches, but neither is wheelchair accessible.

We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause and encourage visitors who may require assistance to contact the organisers in advance so that we can advise on the available arrangements.
result.accommodationIntro: Accommodation guidance for the Stellenbosch area is still being put together.

emergencyContacts.label: All emergencies, from a mobile phone
emergencyContacts.note: Works from any mobile, including one with no airtime.

result.faqContactNote: Not answered here? We would rather hear the question than have you guess.
result.faqIntro: Answers to what visitors ask us most. Many of these depend on details the show committee has not yet confirmed; those answers are marked as such and will be updated as the arrangements firm up.
result.food: There is a restaurant on site as well as food vendors will be available.
result.gettingThereIntro: Designated Parking for the National Orchid Show will be provided at the Stellenbosch flying club. Please follow the signage from the R44 on arrival instructions will be provided by the Parking Attendants on where to park. Parking is free.
result.parking: Yes, secure parking is available at the show and the symposium.
result.pendingLabel: To be confirmed by the show committee
result.photographyPolicy:
Photography of all plants and exhibition stands are allowed. Should you take photographs of attendees or the public please ensure that you get their express permission should you wish to publish these on or in any public content.

All rights are reserved by the management committee to use photographs of the event that are publicly available.
result.planIntro: Everything you need to get to the National Orchid Show and make a day of it. Travel and accommodation guidance for the venue is still being put together; the show committee will confirm the final details.
result.publicTransport: If you plan to use e-hailing services to get to the National Orchid Show please note that they will have a designated drop off and pick up point. This will be provided by the Parking attendants at the venue.
result.researchLabel: Researched by the web team — not yet confirmed by the show committee
